en.name: Table
description: With the introduction of fritware, which is more cohesive than earthenware in its working state, twelfth-century Syrian potters branched out into producing ceramic furniture, such as this turquoise-glazed table. Six-sided tables of this type are believed to be based on wooden versions that have not survived. Perhaps in reference to the spaces in which they were used, the tables feature architectural motifs, such as the miniature pillars (balusters) on the sides and the pierced tabletop that resembles a *mashrabiya*, a type of window screen with openwork geometric design.
holder: Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA)
dates: Hegira late 6th century-early 7th century / AD late 12th-early 13th century
keywords: Furnishing; fritware; ceramic; moulding; glazed; Ayyubid; Syria; architectural motifs; mashrabiya; geometric design; openwork
partner: Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA)

en.name: Water Museum
description: This is the first water museum of South Asia. The Water Museum was created to spread information and raise awareness among communities, stakeholders, and policymakers about the importance of safeguarding rivers. It serves as a strong foundation for the policy advocacy of the "Water Commons" campaign by ActionAid Bangladesh and a call to action to save rivers in South Asia.
keywords: Water; museum; monument

en.name: Long Neck Cylindrical Bottle
description: Cylindrical bottle made of thin, colourless, transparent glass. The neck of the bottle is cylindrical and very long. The rim is of an irregular, round shape made by the application of glass thread. The neck, shoulder and most recipients are decorated with spiral flutes, turned to the right. The bottom is extremely concave. The bottle is almost completely coated with a layer of milky white irridation. Presumed to be part of the tableware, these were found in the remainder of a building with more recent ceramic and one metal, partly recognizable object. According to Millica Križanac's research based upon excavated archaeological material, the building is dated as of the late 18th and early 19th centuries. Sremska Mitrovica came under Austrian control after almost two centuries of Turkish rule during the war of 1710–1718. As a trading centre on Sava, it attracted primarily residents of the surrounding area. Modest trade existed between Sremska Mitrovica and other towns, as well as with Belgrade, Vienna and Budapest.
place: Venice. The object was discovered in the archaeological site in Sremska Mitrovica, as verified by the research of Millica Križanac.
keywords: Venetian; Tableware

en.name: Husaynite Madrasa
description: Founded in 1122/1710 by the first Husaynite Prince, Husayn Ibn ‘Ali, it is one of the oldest Kairouanese *madrasa*s that has been past down on to us; as such, it holds a special place within the history of Kairouanese architecture. The rectangular doorway, framed by *kadhal* piedroits, leads to a hall whose ceilings are painted with geometric and floral motifs based on the Hispano-Moresque model. The elbow-shaped entrance ends in a courtyard surrounded by four galleries featuring horseshoe arches resting on Ottoman-type capitals. The acroter is made of green tiles, definitely Hispano-Moresque in influence. There are 11 rooms surrounding the courtyard; they are covered by barrel vaults. On the south-east side stands the mosque: it is composed of two bays and of three barrel-vaulted bays, supported on circular pillars. In earlier days, a stucco decor adorned part of the walls; nothing but a few fragments of it remain. The niche of the *mihrab* is surmounted by a semi-circular horseshoe arch. The plan of this *madrasa* is based on that of the *ribat*s, composed uniquely of a ground floor. This monument was restored during the 1980s by the Association for the Safeguarding of the Medina. It is now used as the old town’s local Town Hall.

es.name: Medersa Husseiní (opción)
description: Fundada en 1122/1710 por el fundador de la dinastía, Hussein ibn Alí, es una de las *medersa*s más antiguas de Kairuán. De hecho, ocupa un lugar especial en la historia arquitectónica de la ciudad. Su puerta rectangular, enmarcada en pilastras de *kadhal*, lleva a un vestíbulo cuyos techos aparecen pintados con motivos geométricos y florales inspirados en el modelo hispano-morisco. La entrada en codo llega hasta el patio rodeado por cuatro galerías, cuyos arcos de medio punto reposan sobre capiteles de tipo otomano. La acrótera en tejas verdes está claramente emparentada con el estilo hispano-morisco. Once habitaciones cubiertas por bóvedas de cañón rodean el patio. La mezquita está situada en la parte sudeste, con dos tramos y tres naves con bóvedas de cañón que descansan sobre pilares circulares. Una decoración en estuco adornaba parte de los muros, aunque no quedan más que algunos fragmentos. El nicho del *mihrab* está coronado por un arco de medio punto. La planta de esta *medersa* está inspirada en la de los *ribat*s que únicamente ocupan una planta baja. Este monumento ha sido restaurado en los años 80 por la Asociación para la Salvaguardia de la Medina. Sirve actualmente para el Ayuntamiento de la ciudad antigua.

fr.name: Médersa husseinite (option)
description: Fondée en 1122/1710 par le premier prince husseinite Hussein Ibn Ali, elle est l’une des plus anciennes médersas kairouanaises qui nous soient parvenues; de ce fait, elle occupe une place particulière dans l’histoire de l’architecture kairouanaise. La porte rectangulaire, encadrée de pieds-droits en *kadhal*, mène à un vestibule dont les plafonds sont peints de motifs géométriques et floraux s’inspirant du modèle hispano-mauresque. L’entrée en chicane aboutit à une cour entourée de quatre galeries dont les arcs sont outrepassés et reposent sur des chapiteaux de type ottoman. L’acrotère est en tuiles vertes, d’influence hispano-mauresque nette. Les chambres, entourant la cour, sont au nombre de onze; elles sont couvertes de voûtes en berceau. Du côté sudest se dresse la mosquée: elle est constituée de deux travées et de trois nefs voûtées en berceau, reposant sur des piliers circulaires. Auparavant, un décor en stuc ornait une partie des murs; il n’en reste que quelques fragments. La niche du *mihrab* est surmontée d’un arc en plein cintre outrepassé. Le plan de cette médersa s’inspire de celui des *ribat*s, formés uniquement d’un rez-de-chaussée. Ce monument a été restauré au cours des années 80 par l’Association de Sauvegarde de la Médina. Il sert actuellement de siège à mairie de l’arrondissement de la ville ancienne.

ar.name: حجر محفور.
description:
القطعة عبارة عن حجر مربع الشكل يوجد عليه نقش قرآني لآية الكرسي وهي الآية رقم 255 من سورة البقرة (رقم 2). والآية تقرأ على النحو التالي: "الله لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم لا تأخذه سنة ولا نوم له ما في السموات وما في الأرض من ذا الذي يشفع عنده إلا بإذنه يعلم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم ولا يحيطون بشيء من علمه إلا بما شاء وسع كرسيه السموات والأرض ولا يؤده حفظهما وهو العلي العظيم".  
  
حفرت هذه الآية على الحجر بالخط الكوفي بشكل عميق، وجاءت في عشرة أسطر. الأحرف طويلة وذات زوايا مما يدل على أن هذا النقش يرجع إلى فترة مبكرة، إذ أن هذا النوع من الأحرف يرجع إلى الفترات الإسلامية المبكرة.  
  
أما بالنسبة لاستخدامات هذا الحجر، فهي مرتبطة بفكرة حماية المنزل وأهله من الحسد. ما يثير الانتباه أن هذا التقليد ما زال شائعاً إلى يومنا هذا، إذ نجد هذه الآية على جدران المنازل من الداخل مكتوبة على ألواح من النحاس المصفح أو على المطرزات أو قطع الحلي التي تستخدم خاصة للأطفال.

حجر منقوش من عمّان، عليه آية الكرسي القرآنية وهي الآية 255 من سورة البقرة. الخط الكوفي أموي أنموذجي. تمثَّلت وظيفة الحجر بحماية صاحبه، وأفراد أسرته، والبيت من "العين الشريرة". مازالت هذه العادة متداولة إلى يومنا هذا.
dates: النصف الأول من القرن 2 ﻫ/ 8 م .
keywords: آية الكرسي؛ خط كوفي؛ قرآن؛ نقش.

en.name: Inscription stone.
description:
A rectangular inscribed stone that has a Qur'anic verse known as 'Ayat al-Kursi' ('the Throne Verse') from Sura 2 (al-Baqara), verse 255:  
  
'God! There is no God but he, the living, the self-subsisting: neither slumber nor sleep seizeth him! To him belong what so ever is in heaven, and on earth. Who is he that can intercede with him, but through his good pleasure? He knows that which is past, and that which is it come unto them, and they shall not comprehend anything of his knowledge, but so far as he pleaseth. His throne is extended over heaven and earth, and preservation of both is no burden unto him. He is the high, the mighty.'  
  
The inscription in *kufic* script is deeply incised into the stone. Comprising about ten lines, the letters are long and angular in shape, an indication that this stone inscription is of an early date. The function of the stone was to protect the owner, his family and the house from the 'evil eye'. This custom is still alive very much alive today; in many Jordanian houses one will still see such blessings on ceramic panels, laminated copper panels, embroideries, and for women and children, gold pendants.

An inscribed stone from Amman with a Qur’anic verse known as Ayat al-Kursi from Sura 2 (al-Baqara), verse 255. The *kufic* script is typically Umayyad. The function of the stone was to protect the owner, his family and the house from the ‘evil eye’. This custom is still very much alive today.
holder: Now on display at Jordan Museum
dates: Hegira, first half of the 2nd century / AD 8th century.
keywords: Inscription; kufic script; Qur’an; Shahada.

es.name: Piedra con inscripción
description:
Piedra rectangular grabada con una inscripción perteneciente a la sura 2 (*al-Baqara*), la aleya 255, conocida como aleya del Trono (*ayat al-Kursi’*): “¡Dios! No hay más dios que Él, el vivo, el autosuficiente. Ni el letargo ni el sueño le rinden. Todo cuanto hay en el cielo y en la tierra le pertenece. ¿Quién puede interceder cerca de él si no es con su permiso? Él conoce el pasado y el futuro de todos, y ellos no abarcan de su ciencia más que lo que Él desea. Su trono se extiende sobre los cielos y sobre la tierra, y su custodia no le es ninguna carga. Él es el Altísimo, el Grande».  
La inscripción se realizó en escritura cúfica profundamente cincelada en la piedra. Posee unas diez líneas de letras alargadas y angulosas, lo que indica una datación temprana. La función de esta piedra era la de proteger del mal de ojo a su propietario, su familia y su casa. Esta costumbre aún perdura en la actualidad; en muchos hogares jordanos todavía puede verse este tipo de bendiciones en paneles de cerámica o cobre laminado, bordados y colgantes de oro que usan mujeres y niños.

Piedra tallada con un versículo coránico, la *ayat al-Kursi* de la sura 2 (*al-Baqara*). La escritura cúfica es típicamente omeya. La piedra, procedente de Ammán, protegía contra el mal de ojo a su dueño, así como a la familia y el hogar de este. Esta costumbre aún perdura.
dates: Primera mitad del siglo II de la Hégira / siglo VIII d. C.
keywords: Inscripción; escritura cúfica; Corán; Shahadah.

fr.name: Pierre votive gravée.
description:
Pierre rectangulaire gravée d'une inscription du verset 255 (“*Ayat al-Kursi*”, Le verset du trône) de la deuxième sourate du Coran (“*al-Baqara*”, La vache de Moïse) :  
“Allah ! Point de divinité à part Lui, le Vivant, Celui qui subsiste par lui-même,'al-Qayyu'. Ni somnolence ni sommeil ne Le saisissent. à lui appartient tout ce qui est dans les cieux et sur la terre. Qui peut intercéder auprès de Lui sans Sa permission? Il connaît leur passé et leur futur. Et, de Sa science, ils n'embrassent que ce qu'Il veut. Son Trône, 'Kursi', déborde les cieux et la terre, dont la garde ne Lui coûte aucune peine. Et Il est le Très Haut, le Très Grand” (trad. Kasimirski).  
L'inscription en coufique de dix lignes environ est gravée en profondeur dans la pierre. Les lettres hautes de forme anguleuse suggèrent un travail très ancien. La fonction de cette pierre était de protéger son propriétaire, sa famille et sa maison du mauvais œil. Cette coutume est restée très vivante de nos jours. Dans de nombreuses maisons jordaniennes, on trouve encore ce type de bénédiction reproduite sur des panneaux de céramique ou de cuivre, des broderies, ou sur des pendentifs en or pour les femmes et les enfants.

Pierre gravée d’Amman portant un verset du Coran connu comme *Ayat al-Kursi* issu de la première sourate, *al-Baqara*, verset 255. L'inscription en coufique est de style omeyyade typique. La fonction de cette pierre était de protéger son propriétaire, sa famille et sa maison du mauvais œil. Cette coutume est restée très usitée de nos jours.
dates: Première moitié du IIe siècle de l’Hégire (VIIIe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: pierre votive ; inscriptions ; écriture coufique ; Coran ; chahadah

en.name: *Map of the Royal Cities of Buda and Pest*
description: The *Map of the Royal Cities of Buda and Pest* depicts all the settlements that bordered Buda: the Roman settlement of *Aquincum;* the border with Budafok and a detail of Óbuda (Old Buda). The city of Pest is also identifiable, together with the two suburbs of Terézváros and Erzsébetváros. During the period, as the map shows, the hills of Buda were not forested because, following Ottoman rule, the inhabitants cultivated vineyards instead. The Royal Castle is identifiable, together with the Viziváros (Watertown) and Tabán. Residents were settled mainly within the city walls up until 1700, after which time the suburbs began to be built. At the end of the 18th century, Buda-Pest became increasingly important as the main commercial and agricultural centre and although the diet was held in Pozsony (Bratislava), the two cities of Buda and Pest were the centre for various political movements, Enlightenment thought, the arts and literature, and as a consequence the population increased to 50,000.
A map of the two cities of Buda and Pest with a more detailed representation of the different parts of the former and a less detailed display of the two suburbs of Pest.
keywords: Map; Buda; Budafok; Óbuda; Old Buda; Pest; Terézváros; Erzsébetváros; Viziváros; Watertown; Tabán; Turks; Ottoman; Buda-Pest; diet; parliament
materials: Pen and ink drawing on paper
tags: Pen and ink drawing on paper

de.name: Deckenfresko
description: Der Knoller-Schüler Schöpf gilt nach seinem Lehrer als einer wichtigsten Meister der Freskomalerei im Übergang vom späten Rokoko zum Frühklassizismus. Das große Kuppelfresko, das die Krönung Mariae darstellt, folgt im Aufbau dem typischen spätbarocken Schema mit Wolkenkranz und Lichtvision in der Mitte, doch ist der Malstil, vor allem bei den Figuren, von großer Konzentration und andächtigem Ernst geprägt. Barockes Pathos weicht zunehmend einer beispielhaft belehrenden Bilderzählung.

en.name: Ceiling fresco
description: Following his apprenticeship, Schöpf, a student of Knoller, is considered one of the most important masters of fresco painting during the transition to Early Classicism. The composition of the large cupola fresco depicting the Coronation of the Virgin Mary follows the Late Baroque scheme with a crown of clouds and vision of light in the centre, however the painting style, above all in the case of the figures, is characterised by concentration and devout earnestness. Baroque pathos is replaced by a salutary pictorial narrative.

en.name: A photograph showing the interior of Porto Municipal Museum
short_description: Creation of Allen Museum in Porto by João Francisco Allen, an Irish origin wealthy wine trader to exhibit his own collection. It was the first Portuguese museum opened to the public, albeit to a very limited way. The visitors were allowed only on Sunday (10.00-15.00), during weekdays the access to the collections was conditioned.

cs.name: Sv. Cyril
description: Šest soch střední části představuje slovanské světce: Věrozvěstové Metoděj, první biskup moravský, Cyril (Konstantin), Vojtěch, biskup pražský, zakladatel prvního benediktinského kláštera v Čechách, Jan Nepomucký, Jan Sarkander, umučený v Olomouci r. 1620 a sv. Blažej, jemuž byl zasvěcen olomoucký kostel, považovaný v baroku za nejstarší vůbec.

en.name: St. Cyril
description: The six statues on the central section represent Slavic saints: Methodius, the first Moravian bishop; Cyril (Konstantin); Vojtěch the Bishop of Prague and founder of the first Benedictine Monastery in Bohemia; John of Nepomuk; John Sarkander, tortured to death in Olomouc in 1620; and St. Blasius to whom the Olomouc Church, considered the oldest Baroque church in the country, was dedicated.

en.name: Nablous : Australian cavalry entering the ancient Shechem, the capital of Samaria
description: A column of Australian cavalry gallops along a road on the valley floor into the small town of Shechem. The rear of the column is in the foreground, with the front of it just entering the town, whose buildings are visible in the distance. The valley is bordered, to the left and right, by steep-sided hills.
place: Department of Information commission transferred to the Ministry of Information and then to the Imperial War Museum.

en.name: Burj Safita
description:
Safita, boasting the largest Crusader tower or *bur*j of the Levant, is located at one of the best observation points in Syria’s mountain ranges. It is also a unique example of an église-donjon, a keep incorporating a chapel. The first verifiable mention of Safita comes from the year 505/1112 as being in the hands of the Crusader County of Tripoli. Located very near to Muslim territories, the fortifications, carried out by the Order of the Temple, were complete by 506/1152. However, even they were unable to hold it against the armies of Nur al-Din who briefly took the area in 562/1166–7 and again 566/1171. During the reign of the Count of Tripoli, Raymond III, the Crusaders repossessed Safita; building of the donjon probably commenced after these events and following the ravages of the earthquake that struck in 565/1170. The campaign of Salah al-Din in 584/1188 passed Safita by, but another earthquake in 598/1202 did much damage.  
The Franks assiduously attended to the damage wrought by the earthquake of 598/1202, together with the siege conducted by the Ayyubid prince al-Malik al-Ashraf in 615/1218. Some sources mention the French King, Louis VII’s participation in improving Safita’s fortifications. Safita went mostly unmolested until 569/1271, when the Templar garrison surrendered the castle to the Mamluks.  
A 27 m-high donjon, or central tower within a castle, dominates the remains of the Citadel of Safita. The donjon, which was practically unknown in Syria before the arrival of the Crusaders, became a regular feature in contemporary European military architecture. Regardless of its European origins the intention of the design for the tower of Safita was to accommodate Levantine requirements. Unlike many of its western contemporaries, its roof is flat and its interior spared from wooden elements. These developments are probably in response to the fear of combustibles used in war, a highly developed weapon in the Near East. The tower, this time similar to its Latin counterparts, consisted of two vaulted levels. On the ground floor, there was a 13.5 m-high grandiose chapel covered by a pointed barrel-vault. This chapel follows the style used by the military orders residing in castles. The Greek Orthodox community of Safita continues to use it as a liturgical area, dedicated to Saint Michael.  
From the left of the entrance, defended by slot machicolations, a stairway leads up from within the thickness of the walls to the first floor hall, which probably served as the dormitory of the Templar Knights’ elite. This elegant hall is divided by three pillars, which support a cross-groined vault of eight bays. The flat roof above the hall preserves remnants of the original crenellations and offers a sweeping view over the surrounding countryside. The Donjon of Safita stood as the strategic centre of the region from where almost all the citadels and towers of the surrounding area were visible, including the Crac des Chevaliers. Large cracks currently seen on the facades of the tower are very possibly evidence of earthquake damage and restoration from the early 7th/13th century.  
Of the two enceintes surrounding the tower, only the outer one, approximately 165 m x 100 m, still visible, remains. Its eastern stretch incorporates the western facade of a large rectangular building of two storeys. The springing of the ribbed vault in the first-floor room bears close resemblance to a similar hall in the Citadel of Tartus.

ar.name: صندوق كتابة.
description:
تم تنفيذ القطعة بالرسم، وتقنية البرنيق (إديرنكاري). وقد زخرف السطح الخارجي للصندوق بكامله بباقات من الزهر فوق أرضية حمراء. إن تصاميم الأزهار ضمن إكليل يتوسط الغلاف المدور، وكذلك في زوايا الصندوق وعلى جوانبه، تعكس جميعها نمط الباروك - الركوكو. تم تدوين اسم الحرفي الذي صنع الصندوق، السيد عمر الرجائي، ضمن رصيعة صغيرة في أسفل الغطاء المزخرف. ويوجد داخل الغطاء طغراء السلطان عبد المجيد الأول (حكم في الفترة 1255- 1278 / 1839- 1861) على خلفية زرقاء.  
  
هنالك داخل الصندوق حجيرات تخزين ريشة الكتابة والحبر ومرشَّة الصقل، وحجرة للورق أيضاً. كانت صناديق الكتابة هذه تُصنع نزولاً عند رغبة الخطاطين في حفظ ورقهم وريشاتهم ومحابرهم وقوالب القص وسكاكينهم ومقصاتهم في مكان واحد. وكان لهذه الصناديق وظيفة أبعد من كونها قطعاً زخرفية؛ حيث كانت تزخرف بما يتناسب وذوق العصر، وغالباً ما يطعم الخشب بعروق اللؤلؤ والعاج وعظم السلحفاة. وأحياناً، كما في هذه العينة، كانت تصنع بتقنية البرنيق التي كانت شائعة في القرن 13 / 19.  
  
لقد كانت الزخرفة الكتابية أحد أهم المجالات التي عبر من خلالها الفن الإسلامي عن نفسه. فالسلاطين العثمانيون على وجه الخصوص تلقوا دروساً في الخط وكونوا أنماطهم الخاصة؛ حيث يعتبر أحمد الثالث ومصطفى الثاني ومحمود الثاني وعبد المجيد الأول من بين السلاطين البارعين في فن الخط؛ وصندوق الكتابة هذا صنع للسلطان عبد المجيد الأول، وقد استخدمه شخصياً.

كانت علب الكتابة تُصنع لحفظ أدوات الخطّاطين والكتبة. وقد كانت مُزخرفة وفقاً للذوق السائد في العصر، وهي مطلية بطلاء "اللَّكر" المعروف بالأدرنه كاري في هذه الحالة. أما صاحب هذه العلبة فهو السلطان عبد المجيد الأول، الذي كان هو نفسه خطّاطاً.
keywords: برنيق؛ تقنية إديرنكاري؛ زخرفة كتابية؛ طغراء.

en.name: Writing box.
description:
The object was prepared by painting with lacquer on wood, a technique known as *Edirnekari* . The whole outer surface of the box is decorated with bouquets of flowers on a red ground. The floral designs within the garland in the centre of the rounded cover, as well as in its corners and on the sides of the box, all reflect the Turkish Baroque-Rococo style. Within a small medallion on the bottom of the decorated lid is the name of the craftsman who made the box: 'es-Seyyid ömer er-Recai' (al-Sayyid ‘Umar al-Rija'i). On the inside of the lid is the *tuğra* of Sultan Abdülmecid I (r. AH 1255–78 / AD 1839–61) on a blue background.  
  
Within the box is storage space for a reed pen, ink, and a sand-sprinkler, as well as a compartment for paper. Writing boxes were produced in response to calligraphers' desire to store their paper, reed pens, inkwells, pen-cutting slabs, knives and scissors in one place.  
  
Writing boxes were functional rather than decorative objects. They were decorated according to the taste of the period, usually with mother-of-pearl, ivory, and tortoiseshell inlaid into wood. Sometimes, as with this example, they were made using the *Edirnekari* technique, which was common in the AH 13th / AD 19th century.  
  
Calligraphy is one of the greatest fields in which Islamic art has expressed itself. The Ottoman sultans in particular took lessons in calligraphy and created their own examples. Among the sultans proficient in the art of calligraphy might be counted Ahmed III, Mustafa II, Mahmud II and Abdülmecid I, and this writing box was made for and personally used by Abdülmecid I.

Writing boxes were made to store the tools of calligraphers and scribes. They were decorated according to the taste of the period, in this case in a lacquer technique known as *Edirnekari*. Its owner was Sultan Abdülmecid I, who was himself a calligrapher.
holder: Museum of Turkish and Islamic Arts.
dates: Reign of Sultan Abdülmecid I (r. Hegira 1255–78 / AD 1839–61).
keywords: Calligraphy; Edirnekari technique; lacquer, Sultan Abdülmecid I; tugra.
tags: Es-Seyyid Ömer Er-Recai (al-Sayyid  Umar Al-Rija I)
partner: Museum of Turkish and Islamic Arts

es.name: Escribanía.
description:
Este objeto está decorado con laca sobre madera, con una técnica conocida como *edirnekari*. Toda la superficie exterior de la caja está adornada con ramos de flores sobre un fondo rojo. La tapa es abombada y presenta una guirnalda central que contiene diseños florales, que también están presentes en las esquinas y los laterales de la caja, todos realizados al estilo barroco-rococó turco. En la parte inferior de la tapa, dentro de un medallón pequeño, se lee el nombre del artesano que fabricó la escribanía: es-Seyyid Ömer er-Recai. Por dentro de la tapa se ve la *tugra* del sultán Abdülmecid I (r. 1255-1278 / 1839-1861) sobre fondo azul.  
Dentro de la escribanía hay compartimentos para el papel, la pluma de caña, la tinta y el esparcidor de arena. Las escribanías cumplían con los requisitos de los calígrafos, que necesitaban guardar en el mismo sitio el papel, el cálamo, el tintero, la tablilla para cortar plumas, el cortaplumas y las tijeras.  
Las escribanías tenían un fin práctico, no decorativo, pero se adornaban según los gustos de cada periodo, normalmente con incrustaciones de nácar, marfil y caparazón de tortuga en madera. Algunas veces, como en este caso, se adornaban con la técnica de lacado *edirnekari*, común en el siglo XIII / XIX.  
La caligrafía es una de las principales formas de expresión del arte islámico. Los sultanes otomanos aprendían caligrafía y creaban sus propios modelos. En este campo, destacaron los sultanes Ahmed III, Mustafa II, Mahmud II y Abdülmecid I. Esta escribanía se fabricó para uso personal de Abdülmecid I.

Las escribanías se fabricaban para almacenar los útiles de calígrafos y escribas. Se decoraban según los gustos del periodo; en este caso, se usó la técnica de lacado *edirnekari*. Su dueño fue el sultán Abdülmecid I, que también fue calígrafo.
holder: Museo de Arte Turco e Islámico.
dates: Durante el sultanato de Abdülmecid I (r. 1255-1278 de la Hégira / 1839-1861 d. C.)
keywords: Caligrafía; técnica Edirnekari; laca; sultán Abdülmecid I; tuğra.
partner: Museo de Artes Turcas e Islámicas

fr.name: Écritoire.
description:
écritoire en bois laqué (technique *Edirnekari*) décoré extérieurement de bouquets de fleurs sur fond rouge. Les motifs floraux de la guirlande figurant au centre du couvercle bombé ainsi que dans les angles et sur les faces latérales sont de style baroque-rococo turc. Dans un petit médaillon à la base du couvercle figure le nom de l'artisan qui a fabriqué cette boîte : Es-Seyyid ömer er-Recai (al-Sayyid 'Umar al-Rija'i). à l'intérieur du couvercle est peint le *tugra* du sultan Abdülmecid Ier (r. 1255-1278 de l'Hégire / 1839-1861 J.-C.) sur fond bleu. Le volume intérieur est aménagé pour le rangement d'une plume en roseau, d'encre, d'un sablier et de papier – pour lequel est prévu un compartiment spécial. Les écritoires répondaient au besoin de réunir et de conserver ensemble papier, plume de roseau, encriers, plaquette de coupe, couteaux et ciseaux. Objets fonctionnels plus que décoratifs, ils étaient décorés selon le goût de la période, souvent d'incrustations de nacre, d'ivoire et d'écaille de tortue sur bois. Ils pouvaient aussi, comme ici, être laqués, technique appréciée au XIIIe siècle H (XIXe siècle J.-C.).  
La calligraphie est l'un des grands domaines dans lequel l'art islamique a exprimé toute sa personnalité. Les sultans ottomans en particulier apprenaient la calligraphie et écrivaient leurs propres textes. Parmi les sultans habiles dans cet art figurent Ahmed III, Moustafa II, Mahmoud II et Abdülmecid Ier.

Les écritoires étaient faits pour ranger les ustensiles des calligraphes et des scribes. Ils étaient décorés selon le goût de l’époque – celui-ci selon une technique de laque appelée *Edirnkari*. Son propriétaire était le sultan Abdülmecid Ier, qui était lui-même calligraphe.
holder: Musée des arts turcs et islamiques.
dates: Règne du sultan Abdülmecid Ier (r. 1255-1278 de l’Hégire / 1839-1861 J.-C.).
keywords: Calligraphie ; technique Edirnekari ; laque ; sultan Abdülmecid Ier
partner: Musée des arts turques et islamiques

tr.name: Yazı Çekmecesi.
description:
Ahşap üzerine Edirnekari tekniğinde boyanarak hazırlanmıştır. çekmecenin tüm dış yüzeyi kırmızı zemin üzerine yapılan çiçek buketleri ile bezenmiştir. Bombeli olan kapağın ortasındaki çelengin içinde, köşelerinde ve çekmecenin yan yüzlerinde yer alan çiçeklerin oluşturduğu bu desen şeması, Türk Barok-Rokoko üslubunu yansıtmaktadır. çekmece kapağındaki bezemenin altında küçük bir madalyon içinde çekmeceyi yapan usta adını, “es-Seyyid ömer er-Recai” olarak yazmıştır. Mavi renge boyanmış olan çekmece kapağının iç yüzünde Sultan Abdülmecid'in (1255-1278 / 1839-1861) tuğrası, alt kısımda ise kamış kalem, mürekkep ve rıhdanlığın konulacağı özel yerler ile kağıtların muhafaza edileceği bölüm bulunmaktadır.  
  
Yazı çekmeceleri, Hattatların, kağıt, kamış kalem, mürekkep hokkası, makta, kalemtraş ve yazı makaslarını muhafaza etmek ve bir arada bulundurmak istekleri sonucu üretilmişlerdir.  
  
Yazı çekmeceleri kullanım amacı dolayısıyla üretilmiş, dönem beğenisi doğrultusunda bezenmiş, genellikle ahşap üzerine sedef, fildişi, bağa kakmalı olarak, bazen de bu eserde olduğu gibi 19. yüzyılda sıkça görülen Edirnekari tekniğinde yapılmışlardır.  
  
İslam sanatının kendini ifade ettiği en büyük alanlardan biri hat sanatıdır. özellikle bazı Osmanlı sultanları da hat sanatında ders almış ve çalışmalar yapmıştır. Hat sanatında güzel eserler vermiş sultanlar arasında III. Ahmed, II. Mustafa, II. Mahmud ve I. Abdülmecid sayılabilir. Bu yazı çekmecesi, Sultan I. Abdülmecid tarafından bizzat kullanılmıştır.

Yazı çekmeceleri, hattatların araç gereçlerini toplu halde taşıma ve koruma kolaylığını sağlamak üzere yapılmışlardır. üretildikleri dönemin beğenisi doğrultusunda bezenen bu çekmeceler, her dönemde hattatların üstün zevk değerlerini de yansıtmışlardır.
keywords: Yazı; edirnekari; lake; I. Abdülmecid; tuğra; hat

short_description: Léontine Zanta (not Lauta, as indicated by the photograph) was the first French woman to receive a literature degree (not a philosophy degree), writing her thesis on revival of Stoicism in the 16th century. A journalist, teacher and novelist, she was also very interested in feminism.

fr.name: Melle Lauta, première femme licenciée en philosophie
short_description: Léontine Zanta (et non pas Lauta comme l’indique la légende de la photographie) a été en 1914 la première femme française docteur ès lettres (et non pas licenciée de philosophie) avec une thèse sur la renaissance du stoïcisme au XVIe siècle. Journaliste, enseignante, romancière, elle s’est beaucoup intéressée à la question du féminisme.

cs.name: Opatství premonstrátů Nová Říše
description: Kostel je jednolodní stavba se dvěma bočními kaplemi a dvěma kvadratickými věžemi. Je 45 m dlouhý, 12 m široký v hlavní lodi a 9 m v presbytáři. Hlavní oltář je dílem benátského malíře A. Entze (1705), retabulum vytvořil mramorář J. I. Hennevogel, činný také v sesterském klášteře v Gerasu. Reálná architektura splývá s iluzivní malbou (šambrány, parapety) a vytváří jednotný barevný prostor. Nad kněžištěm je zobrazeno Předání klíčů sv. Petrovi – založení církve, čtyři figurální alegorie nad pilíři presbytáře znázorňují čtyři tehdy známé světadíly, ve kterých je hlásáno evangelium. Freska na klenbě hlavní lodi představuje duchovní proměnu Šavla z Tarzu na jeho cestě do Damašku (Skt. 9/1-18). Malby patří mezi vrcholná díla J. L. Krackera, činného v Čechách, na Moravě i v Uhrách.

Hlavní oltář klášterního kostela je dílem benátského malíře A. Entze (1705), retabulum vytvořil mramorář J. I. Hennevogel, činný také  
v sesterském klášteře v Gerasu. Reálná architektura splývá s iluzivní malbou (šambrány, parapety) a vytváří jednotný barevný prostor. Nástropní malba je mistrovským dílem J. L. Krackera, malíře působícího v Praze, ve Znojmě a v Uhrách. Klášter je známý cennou obrazárnou. Část děl byla zakoupena od vídeňského dvorního sekretáře  
F. Mayerswalda r. 1804.
artist: Pavel Weinberger, Bartoloměj Hassler, Bernhard Jiří Rothmiller, Adam Enz, Johann Ignaz Hennevogel (1727–1790) Johann Lucas Kracker (1717 Vídeň – 1779 Eger), Iganz Mayer (kolem 1720 Štýrský Hradec – 1785 Brno)
history:
Původně ženský klášter P. Marie převzali premonstráti z Brna-Zábrdovic počátkem 17. století. Nedokončenou stavbu P. Weinbergera zničil r. 1683 požár. R. 1733 byl klášter povýšen na opatství. Protože zde fungovalo gymnázium, nebyl klášter v rámci josefínských reforem zrušen. Po úpravách konventu a novém vybavení kostela byla postavena prelatura. Klášter je známý cennou obrazárnou. Část děl byla zakoupena od vídeňského dvorního sekretáře  
F. Mayerswalda r. 1804. R. 1942 byl po atentátu na říšského protektora Heydricha klášter přepaden jednotkami SS a proměněn v středisko Hitlerjugend. Všichni členové řádu zahynuli v koncentračních táborech. Krátce po skončení války se stal sotva obnovený klášter nežádoucím komunistickému režimu. R. 1950 byli řeholníci zatčeni a v zinscenovaném procesu odsouzeni k mnoha letům vězení a pracovním táborům. Z kláštera se stalo vojenské skladiště. R. 1991 byly zchátralé budovy navráceny řádu.
keywords: Eucharistie, sakristie, refektář

en.name: Premonstratensian Abbey, Nová Říše
description: The church is a single-nave building with two side chapels and two square towers. It is 45 m long, 12 m wide at the nave, and 9 m wide in the presbytery. The high altar of the monastery church is by the Venetian artist A. Entz (1705); the retable was created by the marble craftsman J. I. Hennevogel, also active in an affiliated monastery in Geras. The “real” architecture merges with illusionary painting (the masonry trimmings and ledges), creating a unified space. Above the chancel is the *Giving of the Keys to St. Peter* – the establishment of the Church. Four figurative allegories above the presbytery pillars represent the four continents (at the time) to which the Gospel is spread. The fresco on the nave vault represents the spiritual transformation of Saul on the road to Damascus. The paintings are by J. L. Kracker, an artist active in Prague, Znojmo and Hungary.

The high altar altarpiece of the monastery church is by the Venetian artist A. Entz (1705); the retable was created by the marble craftsman J. I. Hennevogel, also active in an affiliated monastery in Geras. The “real” architecture merges with illusionary painting (the masonry trimmings and ledges), creating a unified space. The ceiling painting is by J. L. Kracker, an artist active in Prague, Znojmo and Hungary. The monastery boasts a picture gallery; some of the works of which were purchased from F. Mayerswald, secretary to the Viennese court in 1804.
artist: Pavel Weinberger, Bartoloměj Hassler, Bernhard Jiří Rothmiller, Adam Enz, Johann Ignaz Hennevogel (1727–1790) Johann Lucas Kracker (1717 Vienna – 1779 Eger), Ignaz Mayer Sr. (c. 1720 Graz – 1785 Brno)
history: The original convent of the Virgin Mary was taken over by the Premonstratensians from Brno-Zábrdovice in the early 17th century. The unfinished building by P. Weinberger was destroyed by fire in 1683. In 1733 the monastery was promoted to abbey status. As it housed a grammar school, the monastery was not dissolved in the course of the religious reforms undertaken by Joseph II. When the monastery was refurbished and refurnished, a prelature was constructed. The monastery houses a picture gallery; some of the works of which were purchased from F. Mayerswald, secretary to the Viennese court in 1804. In 1942, the monastery was occupied by SS troops after the assassination of Reichsprotektor Heydrich and it was turned into a Hitler Youth centre. All the members of the Premonstratensian order died in concentration camps. Shortly after the Second World War, the restored monastery became undesirable for the communist regime. In 1950 the monks were arrested and in a staged trial sentenced to many years in prison and labour camps. The monastery was then converted into a military storehouse. The buildings, by now in a dilapidated state, were returned to the Premonstratensian order in 1991.
keywords: Eucharist, sacristy, refectory

ar.name: ثوب أبو ردان
description:
ثوب أبو ردان أسود من القماش القطني عليه تطريز كثيف بأكمام عريضة. القبة عليها تطريز بأشكال هندسية (مراوح) وفتحة طوق ملونة. الكتف مطرز بغرزة نيشان، وعلى الأكمام يوجد تطريز كثيف من عرق السرو على شكل تموجات، وتحتوي كذلك على شريط أصفر على طول فتحة الكم المردن. على جوانب الثوب (البنايق) يوجد تطريز كثيف بعدة ألوان بأشكال نباتية يعلوها ما يسمى المقص، وعلى مقدمة الثوب من الأسفل (الردفة الأمامية) تطريز من عرق السرو على شكل تموجات بألوان مختلفة. أما على الردفة الخلفية، هناك تطريزيعرف بخيمة الباشا ويعلوها أشكال هندسية ومن ثم عرق السرو. وعلى ذيل الثوب يوجد شريط من اللون الأزرق يتكون من صفين عند الردفة الأمامية والخلفية. يستخدم هذا الثوب بشكل أساسي للاحتفالات، حيث ترتديه النساء غير المتزوجات فقط، في المناسبات مثل حفلات الزفاف والحفلات الخاصة بالنساء. نسج وطرزهذا الثوب يدويًا، وهو من إنتاج نفس النساء اللواتي ارتدينه، حيث يظهرهذا الثوب قدرة المرأة المميزة على الإنتاج. يرجع أصل هذا الثوب الى منطقة بئر السبع، ومدينة بئر السبع كانت عاصمة صحراء النقب. جزء من سكان مدينة بئر السبع هم في الأصل قبائل بدوية، وهو ما يفسر سبب اعتياد نساء بئر السبع على ارتداء هذه الأثواب الثقيلة، لتتماشى مع طبيعة المناخ الصحراوي في تلك المنطقة، فهي تمنع الرمل من دخول جسد المرأة وحمايتها من الحر والشمس. تم اقتناء هذا الثوب عام 1983، وتلبسه نساء منطقة بئر السبع فقط، الثوب فريد من حيث الألوان والغرز والزخارف التي يحملها. وتجدر الإشارة إلى أنه على الرغم من أن الأزياء الفلسطينية التقليدية تتميز بفردانيتها، إلا أنها أيضا تأثرت بشكل لافت بالمراحل التاريخية المختلفة التي شهدتها فلسطين عبر تاريخها الطويل، مثل الفترة العثمانية والانتداب البريطاني، وفي هذا الثوب يظهر التأثير العثماني من خلال الأكمام الطويلة.  
تاريخ الحصول على القطعة: 1983 م.
dates: النصف الأول من القرن التاسع عشر
keywords: تقليدي، منسوجات فلسطينية، ثوب

en.name: Abu Radan Dress
description: Black dress with wide, open sleeves, made from cotton fabric with heavy embroidery. The chest panel shows geometrical motifs (fans) on a rose-coloured collar. The shoulders show an embroidered emblem that is known as *nishan*, and the sleeves are heavily embroidered with cypress trees and waves that include yellow braid work along the length of the sleeve. The side panels of the dress (*banayeq*) show braid work with floral motifs topped by a scissor motif (*maqas*). The lower front panel of the dress shows motifs of cypress branches in different colours. The back shows the Pasha’s tent motif bordered by geometrical figures and cypress branches, while the bottom edge of the back panel has two blue lines that go around the dress. This type of dress was used mainly for celebrations and was worn by unmarried women only for events like weddings and women-only parties. These dresses were produced by hand by the same women who wore them, thus demonstrating the female’s ability to be productive. The origins of this dress lie in Bir al-Sabe, which is one of the largest cities in Palestine and is also known as the capital of the Negev desert. Some Bir al-Sabe inhabitants are originally Bedouin tribes, which explains why the women of Bir al-Sabe used to wear these heavy dresses. The garment has the advantage of being heavy, which helps the wearer cope with the desert climate in that region; it prevents sand from entering the women’s bodies and protects them from the heat. The dress is only worn by the women of Bir al-Sabe, and it is unique to them in respect of all the colours, stitches and motifs that the dress exhibits. It is worth mentioning that while Palestinian traditional costumes are distinguished by their individuality and regionalism, they still exhibit the influence of the different stages of occupation that Palestine has witnessed throughout its long history. In this case, the Ottoman influence is reflected in the long sleeves of the dress.
keywords: Traditional; Palestinian Textile; Dress

en.name: Proclamation of the kingdom in the Romanian Parliament
Press release about Raml Tramway
short_description: A press release in the Al-Ahram newspaper regarding the Raml Tramway and related views of the Prime Minister at that time. The tramway of Alexandria was the first method of mass transportation in Egypt and in Africa, and the most common. The tramway began operating in 1860, and is thus considered the oldest tramway in Africa – and among the oldest in the world.

en.name: Photograph of a classroom at a traditional Qur'anic school
description: In 1914, the French Protectorate put forward a new policy to modernise the education system in Morocco. Integrating the new policy with the traditional education system, scholars (the *'ulama´*) of al-Qarawiyyin University modernised educational material while still respecting the old system.

ar.name: كاشمة من قبل النظامي
description: هذه مخطوطة معروضة بشكل غني وبشكل مذهَّب للخمسة النظامية في طراز تركماني للرسم والتي أنتجت في إيران في العام 904-5 هجري (1498-99 ميلادي). والخمسة هي كتاب خماسي الأجزاء ألف من قبل أبو محمد إلياس ابن يوسف ابن مؤيد (535-605 هجري / 1141-1209 ميلادي) المعروف بالنظامي والتي هي من أعظم الأشعار الرومانسية للأدب الفارسي . وهي مكتوبة بشكل أبيات ثنائية مقفاة تعرف بالمسنافي وتتألف خماسيات نظامي من عمل تعليمي وأربعة أجزاء رومانسية والتي أبطالها من أصل تاريخي. والقصص هي كالتالي : مخزن الأسرار - خسرو وشيرين – ليلي والمجنون  – الجميلات السبع – الإسكندرنامة(قصة الإسكندر).

en.name: *Khamsa* by Nizami
description: This is a lavishly illustrated and illuminated manuscript of Nizami’s *Khamsa* in a painterly Turkoman style that was produced in Iran in AH 904-5 (AD 1498-99). The *Khamsa* is a quintet book composed by Abu Muhammad Ilyas ibn Yusuf ibn Mu’ayyad (AH 535–605 / AD 1141–1209) known as Nizami, who is one of the greatest romantic poets of Persian literature. It is written in rhyming couplets known as *masnavi*. Nizami’s quintet consists of didactic work and four romances, whose heroes have a historical origin. The stories are as follow: *Makhzan al-Asrar* (The Treasury of Secrets), *Khusraw va Shirin* (Khusraw and Shirin), *Layla va Majnun* (Layla and Majnun), *Haft Paykar* (The Seven Beauties) and *Iskandarnama* (The Story of Iskandar).
materials: Paper bound in leather with gilt-stamping
tags: Paper bound in leather with gilt-stamping

ar.name: طبق مقعر.
description: طبق مقعّر مزخرف بالأخضر والأحمر والأزرق والأبيض وحدود سوداء. يقف طائران أسطوريان من الجوارح على شجيرات مليئة بالحراشف ومحاطة بأغصان من زهر الخوخ، التي تشكل زخارف الموقع المركزي المتوضع داخل ميدالية. تظهر على الصحن رؤوس الجوارح مزدانة بالتيجان، في حين يأخذ جسمها شكل تنين مجنح. يرتبط تصوير هذه الكائنات الأسطورية بكثير من الخرافات الحيوانية، ويتجلى بصفات متنوعة. كما تبدو على حواف الصحن كلاب الصيد وهي تلاحق عصافير وقطة وأرانب وزوجاً من البوم متقابلين. ويحتوي حرف وكعب الصحن على ثقبين يستعملان من أجل تعليقه.
طبق مقعر مزخرف بطائرين جارحين أسطوريين معلقين على شجيرات مليئة بالحراشف ومحاطة بباقات من أزهار شجرة البرقوق. زخرفت الحافة بمشهد حي يُظهر كلاب صيد تلاحق عصافير، وقطة وأرانب برية.
keywords: إزنيق؛ صحن؛ خزف؛ طلاء الفخّار؛ طلاء مزجج؛ العثمانيون.

en.name: Deep bowl.
description: A deep dish decorated in green, red, blue and white with black outlines. Two harpies opposite one another are perched on bushes filled with scales, and flanked by boughs of plum-tree flowers which form the decoration of the central field inscribed inside a medallion. On this dish the harpies have a crowned female head and the body of a winged dragon. The depiction of harpies, mythical creatures, is related to various animal fables and takes different forms. Running around the flattened edge of the piece is a frieze of hunting dogs chasing birds, a cat, hares and a pair of owls facing one another. There are two holes in the border and on the foot-ring for hanging the bowl.

Deep dish with a depiction of two facing harpies perched on bushes filled out with scales and flanked by bunches of plum blossom. The brim is decorated with a lively scene showing hunting dogs chasing birds, a cat and hares.
keywords: bowl; ceramic; engobe; glaze; Ottomans; Iznik
materials: Ceramic made from siliceous clay, painted onto engobe (slip) beneath a transparent glaze.
tags: Ceramic made from siliceous clay, painted onto engobe (slip) beneath a transparent glaze.

es.name: Cuenco.
description: Cuenco decorado en verde, rojo, azul y blanco, con contornos en negro. Dos arpías afrontadas y de cuerpo escamoso, posadas sobre arbustos y flanqueadas por ramos de flores de ciruelo, constituyen la decoración del campo central inscrito en un medallón. Las arpías tienen cabeza de mujer coronada y cuerpo de dragón alado. La representación de arpías, criaturas míticas, estaba relacionada con diferentes fábulas de animales y adquirió características propias. En el vuelo del cuenco se observan perros de caza persiguiendo aves, un gato, liebres y un par de búhos afrontados. Los dos orificios del vuelo servían para colgar el objeto.

Cuenco en que están representadas dos arpías afrontadas posadas sobre arbustos rellenos con escamas y flanqueadas por ramos de flores de almendro. En el vuelo, una movida escena muestra perros de caza persiguiendo pájaros, un gato y liebres.
dates: Hacia 987-992 de la Hégira / 1580-1585 d. C.
keywords: cuenco; cerámica; engobe; vidriado; otomanos; Iznik.
materials: Cerámica silicosa pintada sobre engobe y bajo vidriado transparente.
tags: Cerámica silicosa pintada sobre engobe y bajo vidriado transparente.

fr.name: Assiette creuse.
description: Assiette creuse décorée en vert, rouge, bleu et blanc, contours noirs. Deux harpies affrontées sont posées sur des arbustes remplis d'écailles et entourés de branches de fleurs de prunier constituant le décor du champ central inscrit sur un médaillon. Sur l'assiette, les harpies présentent la tête couronnée et le corps d'un dragon ailé. La représentation des harpies, créatures mythiques, est liée aux différentes fables animalières et revêt différentes caractéristiques. Sur le bord, des chiens de chasse poursuivent des oiseaux, un chat, des lièvres et un couple de hiboux affrontés. Deux orifices sur le bord et sur le talon pour la suspension.

Assiette creuse décorée de deux harpies affrontées perchées sur des arbustes remplis d'écailles et entourés de bouquets de fleurs de prunier. Le bord est décoré d'une scène vivante montrant des chiens de chasse poursuivant des oiseaux, un chat et des lièvres.
keywords: assiette; céramique; engobe; glaçure; ottomans; Iznik
materials: Céramique siliceuse peinte sur engobe et sous glaçure transparente.

pt.name: Prato fundo.
description: Prato fundo decorado a verde, vermelho, azul, branco e contornos a negro. Duas harpias afrontadas estão pousadas sobre arbustos preenchidos com escamas e ladeadas por ramos de flores de ameixoeira constituindo a decoração do campo central inscrito num medalhão. As harpias apresentam, neste prato, cabeça feminina coroada e corpo de dragão alado. A representação de harpias, criaturas míticas, está relacionada com diferentes fábulas de animais e assume características diferenciadas. Na aba, cães de caça perseguindo pássaros, um gato, lebres e um par de mochos afrontados. Dois orifícios na aba e no frete para suspensão.

Prato fundo (c. 987-992 AH / c. 1580-1585 AD), no qual estão representadas duas harpias afrontadas pousadas sobre arbustos preenchidos com escamas e ladeadas por ramos de flores de ameixoeira. Na aba, uma movimentada cena mostra-nos cães de caça perseguindo pássaros, um gato e lebres.
keywords: prato; cerâmica; engobe; vidrado; otomanos; Iznik

ar.name: مئذنة القسطل.
description:
تعرف القسطل بقصرها الأموي والمسجد المحاذي له. تحتل المئذنة الزاوية الشمالية الغربية من الساحة التي تتقدم المسجد، وتبرز إلى الخارج عن سمت الجدران المجاورة لها. شيّدت المئذنة بكتل مشذبة من الحجر الجيري. للمئذنه بدن أسطواني قطره 5 م أقيم فوق قاعدة مستطيلة تتألف من ثلاثة مداميك ارتفاعها 1.35 م. يعلو البدن الذي يبلغ ارتفاعه 3.27 م شريط بارز (كورنيش) يحدد بداية الطابق الثاني من المئذنة، وفي نفس الوقت يشكل قاعدة لأعمدة كورنثية لاصقة ناتئة بعض الشيء عن الجدار الخارجي للطابق الثاني من المئذنة. بالرغم من وجود ستة أعمدة حالياً، فإنه يبدو أن القاعدة كانت تسند عشرة أعمدة لاصقة محززة بقنوات ضيقة عمودية. كذلك يبدو أنه في الأصل كانت توجد بين الأعمدة حنيات صماء حفرت فيها فتحات ضيقة للإضاءة والتهوية. أما الدخول إلى المئذنة فكان عبر بوابة عرضها 60 سم تؤدي إلى سلم حلزوني.  
  
تنبع أهمية مئذنة القسطل ليس من شكلها الأسطواني فقط، بل أيضاً من كونها المئذنة الوحيدة الباقية من العصر الأموي في كل أقطار العالم العربي.

يقع قصر ومسجد القسطل المنسوبين إلى يزيد بن عبد الملك (الذي حكم فيما بين عامي 101 - 105 هـ/720 - 724 م) وابنه الوليد (الذي حكم فيما بين عامي 125 - 126 هـ/743 – 744م) على بعد 24 كم جنوب شرق عمَّان. للمئذنة برج مخروطي، قطره 5 م، وارتفاعه 3.27 م، مستند إلى قاعدة مستطيلة. ثمَّة إفريز مُقولب نافر، يُبيِّن بداية الطبقة الثانية. جرى إدخال المئذنة من الزاوية الشمالية الغربية لباحة المسجد عبر باب ضيق، ثم جرى رفع الداخل بسُلَّم لولبيّ. إن مئذنة القسطل، هي المئذنة الوحيدة الباقية من الحقبة الأموية.
keywords: أمويون؛ قصر؛ مئذنة؛ مسجد.

en.name: Al-Qastal Minaret.
description:
Al-Qastal, well known for its Umayyad castle (*qasr*) and adjacent mosque is situated 24 km to the southeast of Amman next to the highway which leads to Queen Alia International Airport.  
The minaret, built of smooth, dressed limestone blocks and laid in header-and-stretcher fashion, forms a salient on the north and west walls of the mosque's courtyard. It has a cylindrical shaft 5 m in diameter and rests on a rectangular base of three courses 1.35 m high. The shaft consists of six courses 3.27 m high. A projecting moulded cornice marks the beginning of the second storey and serves as a base for the channelled Corinthian pilasters. Though only six pilasters currently exist, it seems that originally 10 such pilasters stood on the cornice possibly flanking recessed blind niches pierced by narrow openings or slits.  
The minaret was entered from the northwestern corner of the mosque's courtyard through a narrow door 0.60 m wide, and the interior space was taken up by a spiral staircase which until the turn of the century stood to a level slightly below the top of the pilasters. The door-sill is 2.10 m above the original floor level and there is no evidence of a stairway leading up to it; perhaps a wooden ladder was used to get up to the doorway.  
The minaret at al-Qastal has acquired a particular significance not only because of its cylindrical shape, but also because it is the only extant minaret from the Umayyad period. Contemporary poetry associates al-Qastal and al-Muwaqqar with Caliph Yazid ibn Abd al-Malik (Yazid II, r. AH 101–5 / AD 720–4) and his son al-Walid II (r. AH 125–6 / AD 743–4).

Al-Qastal, known for its Umayyad qasr (castle) and mosque associated with Yazid ibn Abd al-Malik (r. AH 101–5 / AD 720–4) and his son al-Walid (r. AH 125–6 / AD 743–4), is situated 24 km to the southeast of Amman. The minaret has a cylindrical shaft 5 m in diameter and 3.27 m high, resting on a rectangular base. A projecting moulded cornice marks the beginning of the second storey. The minaret was entered from the northwestern corner of the mosque’s courtyard through a narrow door, and the interior was taken up by a spiral staircase. The minaret at al-Qastal is the only extant minaret from the Umayyad period.
artist: Caliph Yazid ibn Abd al-Malik (Yazid II, r. AH 101–5 / AD 720–4).
keywords: Minaret; Mosque; Qasr; Umayyad
partner: Ministry of Tourism & Antiquities, Department of Antiquities

es.name: Alminar de Al-Qastal
description:
Al-Qastal es famosa por su alcázar (*qasr*) omeya y la mezquita adyacente. Su alminar, construido con bloques de piedra caliza cortada y pulida, dispuestos a soga y tizón, forma un saliente sobre los muros norte y oeste del patio de la mezquita. Posee un fuste cilíndrico de 5 m de diámetro y reposa sobre una base rectangular de 1,35 m de altura compuesta por tres hileras de bloques de piedra. El alminar consta de seis hileras de bloques que alcanzan 3,27 m de alto. El inicio de la segunda planta está marcado por una cornisa con una moldura sobresaliente que sirve de base para las pilastras corintias acanaladas. Aunque actualmente sólo quedan seis de estas pilastras, parece que originalmente hubo diez sobre la cornisa, posiblemente flanqueando los nichos ciegos rehundidos que están horadados con finas aberturas o ranuras.  
Al alminar se accedía desde la esquina noroeste del patio de la mezquita, a través de una puerta de sólo 60 cm de ancho. Por dentro subía una escalera de caracol que se mantuvo hasta finales de siglo hasta un nivel ligeramente inferior al de la parte superior de las pilastras. El umbral de la puerta se alza hasta 2,10 m sobre el nivel original del suelo y no existen vestigios de ninguna escalera que condujera más arriba de esta altura, aunque quizá sí se usara una escalera de madera.  
El alminar de al-Qastal ha adquirido singular importancia no sólo por su forma cilíndrica, sino también porque es el único existente datado en el periodo omeya. La poesía de la época relaciona al-Qastal y al-Muwaqqar con el califa Yazid ibn Abd al-Malik (Yazid II, r. 101-105 / 720-724) y con su hijo al-Walid II (r. 125-126 / 743-744).

Al-Qastal, famoso por su *qasr* (alcázar) omeya y su mezquita, vinculados a Yazid ibn Abd al-Malik (r. 101-105 / 720-724) y a su hijo al-Walid (r. 125-126 / 743-744), está 24 km al sureste de Ammán. Su alminar, de base rectangular, tiene un fuste cilíndrico de 5 m de diámetro y 3,27 m de alto. Una cornisa moldeada marca el comienzo de la segunda planta. El alminar tiene dentro una escalera de caracol y se entra a él desde la esquina noroeste del patio de la mezquita. Se trata del único alminar conservado del periodo omeya.
artist: Califa Yazid ibn Abd al-Malik (Yazid II, 101-105 / 720-724).
keywords: Minarete; mezquita; qasr; omeyas.

fr.name: Minaret d’al-Qastal.
description:
Le site d'al-Qastal, très connu pour son château (*qasr*) omeyyade et la mosquée adjacente, se trouve à 24 km au sud-est d'Amman, près de l'autoroute qui conduit à l'aéroport international Queen Alia.  
Construit en blocs de calcaire taillés, parés et montés en carreaux et boutisses, le minaret se détache des murs nord et ouest de la cour de la mosquée. Il est constitué d'un fût cylindrique de 5 m de diamètre et repose sur une base rectangulaire à triple assise de 1,35 m de haut. Le fût comprend six assises sur 3,27 m de haut. Une corniche moulurée marque le début de l'étage et sert de socle à des pilastres corinthiens cannelés. Six seulement sont conservés — mais ils étaient sans doute 10 à l'origine —, flanqués de niches en retrait percées d'ouvertures étroites ou de fentes.  
On pénétrait dans le minaret à l'angle nord-ouest de la cour de la mosquée par une porte étroite de 0,60 m de large. Le volume intérieur était occupé par un escalier en spirale qui, jusqu'au début du XXe siècle, montait jusqu'à un niveau légèrement supérieur au sommet des pilastres. Le seuil de la porte est à 2,10 m au-dessus du niveau du sol et aucune trace n'a été trouvée de présence d'un escalier. Une échelle de bois en faisait peut-être office.  
Ce minaret revêt une signification particulière non seulement pour sa forme cylindrique mais aussi parce qu'il est le seul conservé de la période omeyyade. Des poèmes contemporains relient al-Qastal et al-Mouwaqqar au calife Yazid ibn Abd al-Malik (Yazid II, r. 101-105 H / 720-724 J.-C.) et à son fils al-Walid II (r. 125-126 H / 743-744 J.-C.).

Al-Qastal, connu pour son *qasr* (château) omeyyade et sa mosquée associés à Yazid ibn Abd al-Malik (r. 101-105 H / 720-724 J.-C.) et son fils al-Walid (125-126/743-744), est situé à 24 km au sud-est d’Amman. Le minaret est constitué d’un fût cylindrique de 5 m de diamètre et 3,27 m de hauteur, reposant sur une base rectangulaire. Une corniche moulurée en saillie marque le début du second niveau. On pénétrait dans le minaret à l’angle nord-ouest de la cour de la mosquée par une porte étroite, et le volume intérieur était occupé par un escalier en spirale. Le minaret d’al-Qastal est le seul minaret subsistant de la période omeyyade.
artist: Calife Yazid ibn Abd al-Malik (Yazid II, r. 101-105 H / 720-724 J.-C.).
keywords: minarets ; mosquées ; qasr ; omeyyade

ar.name: قطعتان من الرخام، عليهما بعض النقوش.
description:
قطعتان من الرخام عليهما نقوش عربية بخط ( النسخ)؛ كانتا موجودتين في مغارة كنيسة القبة البالاتينا في باليرمو، ومن المحتمل أنهما كانتا في الأصل في بناء آخر. الكتابة تقول:" اقترب، وقبِّل سحر هذا المكان بعد أن تحتضن جمال الأشياء التي يحويها وتتأملها، لله القوة والبقاء، وعلى الخلق كُتب الفناء، ومن هذا لنا مثل في نبيه". القصد هو الكعبة الشريفة حيث يطوف المؤمنون حولها ويقبّلون الحجر الأسود في زاوية من زواياها. وهو اعتقاد يشابه اعتقاد النورمنديين في تقديس السلطان وإعطائه السلطة الإلهية. وفي الواقع كانت الكتابة في إحدى قاعات القصر الملكي في باليرمو.  
(إن وجودها الموثق في النصف الثاني للقرن التاسع عشر في مغارة القبة البالاتينا يفترض كونها في الأصل في القصر نفسه). ومن الممكن أن روجييرو وضعها خلال إقامته فيه كي يجمع بين القصر والعبادة، مستعملاً صلة الوصل التي عرفت في العصر الفاطمي.
كانت هذه النقائش الكتابية بأحرف نسخية مرصودة على ما يبدو للتزيين والاحتفال بفخامة القصر الملكي حيث تم نقلهم بدون شك من قبل روجي (روجار).
place: مغارة كنيسة القبة البالاتينا، قصر النورمنديين في باليرمو.
keywords: فن العمارة العربية النورمندية، نقش عربي بخط النسخ.
materials: رخام أبيض حفر فيه صورة ثعبان منزّل بحجر آخر.
tags: فن العمارة العربية النورمندية، نقش عربي بخط النسخ.

en.name: Pair of inscriptions.
description: Two fragments of an inscription in cursive Arabic characters (*naskhi*), found in the crypt of the Palatine Chapel in Palermo but probably originally from a different building. The translation of the inscription is as follows: ‘(Come close), kiss the corner of this (building) once you have embraced it and contemplated the beautiful things that it contains – To God the power and the duration. Of his creatures it is written that they will perish; of this we have the example and the comfort of his Prophet’. The reference to the Ka’ba – which the faithful flock around in order to kiss, out of respect, the black stone built into a corner – can be understood in terms of the Norman sovereigns’ attempts to identify with the divine authority. If the inscription does indeed come from one of the halls of the Royal Palace in Palermo (its presence was reported around the second half of the 19th century in the crypt of the Palatine Chapel but this was not its original location, and it may have come from the palace itself), it was probably King Ruggero (Roger) who took it to his residence to allude to the divinity of sovereigns through the traditional Fatimid link between palace and sanctuary.

These beautiful inscriptions in cursive *naskhi* characters were most likely intended to embellish and celebrate the beauty and splendour of the Royal Palace, to which they may have been taken by King Ruggero (Roger).
holder: Regional Gallery of Sicily, Abatellis Palace
place: Crypt of the Palatine Chapel, Norman Palace, Palermo.
keywords: Arab-Norman; naskhi; calligraphy.
materials: White marble with serpentine and porphyry inlay.
tags: White marble with serpentine and porphyry inlay.
partner: Regional Gallery of Sicily - Abatellis Palace

es.name: Fragmentos de inscripción.
description:
Estos dos fragmentos de una inscripción en caracteres árabes cursivos *(nasji)* aparecieron, aunque ya fuera de su lugar original, en la cripta de la Capilla Palatina de Palermo, y quizá provenían de otro edificio. La inscripción puede traducirse como sigue: “\[Acércate,\] besa el canto de este \[edificio\] después de abrazarlo y contempla las cosas hermosas que encierra – A Dios el poder y la perduración. De sus criaturas está escrito que perezcan; de ello tenemos ejemplo y consuelo en su Profeta”.  
La referencia a la Kaaba, alrededor de la cual los fieles giran y en la que besan en señal de respeto la piedra negra tapiada en una esquina, forma parte del ritual de identificación de los soberanos normandos con la autoridad divina. Si la inscripción procede realmente de una de las salas del Palacio Real de Palermo (de hecho, se revela fuera de contexto su presencia en la segunda mitad del siglo XIX en la cripta de la Capilla Palatina, aunque sí podría provenir del propio palacio), sería probablemente el rey Ruggero quien la ordenó colocar en su residencia para aludir a la divinidad de los reyes sirviéndose de la tradición fatimí que vincula el palacio con el santuario.

Estas preciosas inscripciones en caracteres *nasji*, cursivos, estaban destinadas ciertamente a decorar y exaltar la belleza y los fastos del Palacio Real, lugar al que quizás las llevó el rey Ruggero.
holder: Galería Regional de Sicilia Palacio Abatellis
place: Cripta de la Capilla Palatina del Palacio de los Normandos (Palermo).
keywords: arquitectura árabo-normanda; inscripción árabe en caracteres nasji
materials: Mármol blanco con incrustaciones de piedra y serpentina.
tags: Mármol blanco con incrustaciones de piedra y serpentina.
partner: Galería Regional de Sicilia - Palacio Abatellis

fr.name: Deux fragments d’inscriptions.
description: Deux fragments d'une inscription en caractères arabes cursifs (*naskhi*), précédemment dans la crypte de la chapelle Palatine de Palerme, mais provenant peut-être d'un autre édifice ; l'inscription peut être traduite comme suit : “(Approche-toi), baise le coin de cet (édifice) après l'avoir étreint et contemple les belles choses qu'il renferme – À Dieu la puissance et la durée. De Ses créatures il est écrit qu'elles périssent ; nous en avons un exemple et réconfort dans son Prophète.” La référence à la Kaaba, autour de laquelle les fidèles tournaient, et dont ils baisaient en signe de respect la pierre noire murée dans un angle, entre dans le programme d'identification des souverains normands avec l'autorité divine. En effet, si l'inscription provient d'une des salles du Palais royal de Palerme (sa présence hors de ce contexte était signalée dès la seconde moitié du XIXe siècle dans la crypte de la chapelle Palatine, alors qu'elle pourrait, de toute façon, provenir de ce palais), ce fut probablement le roi Roger qui la fit placer dans sa résidence afin de souligner le caractère divin des rois, en utilisant le lien, de tradition fatimide, entre palais et sanctuaire.

Ces très belles inscriptions en caractères *naskhi*, cursifs, étaient destinées, selon toute probabilité, à embellir et à célébrer le faste du Palais royal où elles furent, sans doute, apportées par Roger.
holder: Galerie régionale de la Sicile, palais Abatellis
place: Crypte de la chapelle Palatine, palais des Normands, Palerme.
keywords: architecture arabo-normande ; inscription arabe en caractères naskhi
materials: Marbre blanc avec incrustations de porphyre et de serpentine.
tags: Marbre blanc avec incrustations de porphyre et de serpentine.

it.name: coppia di iscrizioni.
description: due frammenti di una iscrizione in caratteri arabi corsivi (naskhî), già erratica nella cripta della Cappella Palatina di Palermo, ma forse proveniente da un altro edificio; l'iscrizione può essere tradotta: "(Accostati), bacia il canto di questo (edificio) dopo averlo abbracciato e contempla le belle cose che racchiude - A Dio la potenza e la durata. Delle sue creature è scritto che periscano; di ciò abbiamo esempio e conforto nel suo Profeta". Il riferimento alla Ka'ba intorno alla quale i fedeli giravano e baciavano in segno di rispetto la pietra nera murata in un angolo, rientra nel programma di identificazione dei sovrani normanni con l'autorità divina. Se infatti l'iscrizione proviene da una delle sale del Palazzo Reale di Palermo (era infatti decontestualizzata la sua presenza segnalata nella seconda metà del XIX secolo nella cripta della Palatina, mentre potrebbe comunque provenire dallo stesso palazzo), fu probabilmente Ruggero a farla collocare nella sua residenza per alludere alla divinità dei regnanti utilizzando il legame di tradizione fatimide tra palazzo e santuario.

Queste bellissime iscrizioni in carattere *naskhî* , corsivo, erano destinate con tutta probabilità ad abbellire e celebrare la bellezza ed il fasto del palazzo Reale, ove furono, forse, portate da Ruggero.

place: cripta della cappella Palatina, Palazzo dei Normanni, Palermo.
keywords: architettura arabo - normanna; iscrizione araba in caratteri nashki; calligrafia

en.name: Porta Mazara
description:
The Porta Mazara (Gate Mazara) formed part of the south-western medieval wall and was built during the Norman period replacing a former Arab gate, the Bab Ibn Qurhub. The Incisa family restored it in 1325, but its function as entrance to the citadel was already over in the 16th century having been included in the Bastione di Montalto, which formed part of the new and stronger fortified walls of the city. The Porta Montalto was built opposite the old gate, to be demolished later together with the Bastione (1885), bringing to light the old Porta Mazara.  
The gate has three ogival fornixes, in freestone; the two lower, lateral sides are now walled. The remains of the communicating trenches and the service staircase can still be seen above the top of the gate. The remains of frescoes of religious subjects (at least two layers painted at different times) have been found in the lunette of the central fornix.

es.name: Puerta Mazara
description:
Formaba parte de la muralla medieval suroccidental de la ciudad, y se erigió en el periodo normando para sustituir a una puerta árabe anterior, la Bab Ibn Qurhub. En 1325 la restauró la familia de los Incisa; en el siglo XVI había perdido ya su función como puerta de la ciudad, al ser englobada en el Bastión de Montalto, integrado en las nuevas y más poderosas murallas fortificadas de la ciudad. En eje con la vieja puerta se construyó la Puerta Montalto, después demolida junto con el bastión (1885), lo que dejó de nuevo a la vista la antigua Puerta Mazara.  
La puerta tiene tres arcadas ojivales realizadas en piedra cortada; las dos laterales, menores, actualmente están tapiadas. En la parte alta se ven todavía los restos de los caminos de ronda y la escalera de servicio. Restos de frescos de tema religioso (al menos dos capas pintadas en distintas épocas) se han encontrado en la luneta del arco central.

en.name: *The Royal Stock Exchange*
short_description: This illustration of the new Royal Stock Exchange was included in a book called *The Great Metropolis*, published in London by Thomas Holmes in 1851. The book was conceived as an illustrated collection of all the notable monuments in London, providing historical information about the city and about each monument. Although it looks like a tourist guide, it offers more than this kind of guide because it describes not just monuments, but also other landmarks that testify to the social and commercial development of the city. Among the landmarks illustrated and described, as well as the new Royal Stock Exchange, is the Crystal Palace, the site of the Universal Exhibition (the Great Exhibition) of 1851.

ar.name: نبات شوكي الذي ينمو في الجبال ، صفحة من خواص الأشجار
description: إن واحدة من أولى المخطوطات العلمية التي ترجمت من الإغريقية للعربية كانت كتاب ديوسقوريدس المواد الطبية / الأدوية كما كان يسمى باللاتينية. وإن بيديانيوس ديوسقوريدس وهو طبيب إغريقي كتب رسالته عن النباتات الطبية في القرن الأول قبل الميلاد وقد ترجمت المخطوطة مبدئيا للسريانية ثم للعربية في بغداد في القرن التاسع (غويسدون ونوري 2001 ،صفحة 118) وقد أصبحت أساسا لعلم الصيدلة الإسلامي وقد نسخت بشكل واسع .و الصفحة الحالية هي من  نسخة عربية نادرة انتشرت في القرن الثالث عشر  والتي تصور فيها العديد من النباتات الطبية والأعشاب والجذور بدقة مميزة للنصوص العلمية العربية المنتجة خلال تلك الفترة . والرسوم تتبع النموذج الإغريقي بشكل وثيق.واللوحات لا ينقصها الحس الفني ومن أجل الدقة كل عينة ترسم بشكل كلي من القمة للجذر على ورق صقيل والطرف المقابل لهذه الصفحة يصور نبات العليق الأحمر الكبير ذو خمسة فروع شوكية مرتبة بشكل متناظر وتظهر مجموعة الأشطاء الخضراء للنبات والتي يعلوها الازهار الحمراء والعناقيد في قاعدة التبات التي لها جذر أحمر.  النص يعرِّف بالنبات بأنه رازيون rasiyun "" النبات الشوكي الذي ينمو في الجبال "" والجزء الأيسر من الصفحة يبين نبات ذو ساق منفردة ذو أزهار شوكية حمراء ويقول النص أن هذا النبات الطبي يعالج اضطرابات الجلد التي تتضمن البثور والحكة والقروح.

en.name:
The thorny plant that grows in mountains  
Folio from *Khawass al-Ashjar* (*De Materia Medica*)
description: One of the earliest scientific manuscripts to be translated from Greek into Arabic was Dioscorides’s *De Materia Medica*, as it is called in Latin. Pedanius Dioscorides, a Greek physician, wrote his treatise on medicinal plants in the first century CE. The manuscript was initially translated into Syriac and then into Arabic in Baghdad in the 9th century (Guesdon and Nouri 2001, p. 118). It became the foundation for Islamic pharmacology and was copied widely. The present folio is from a rare dispersed 13th-century Arabic copy of the text, in which are depicted various medicinal herbs and roots with an accuracy characteristic of Arab scientific texts produced during this period. The illustrations follow the Greek model closely. The paintings do not lack artistic sensibility and, for accuracy, each specimen is depicted in its entirety from tip to root against the plain paper ground. The recto side of this page depicts a large red bramble plant with five thorned branches arranged symmetrically. A mass of green shoots, topped with red flowers, clusters at the base of the plant, which has a red root. The text identifies the plant as rasiyun, “the thorny plant that grows in the mountains.” The verso side of the page shows a single-stemmed plant with red spiky blossoms, and the text states that this medicinal plant is used in the treatment of skin disorders, including pustules, itching and ulcers.
keywords: Folio; work-on-paper; works-on-paper; plants; science

The stucco ceiling depicts an allegory of the Holy Trinity, and on the walls are paintings by Andre Gonçalves.

A decoração do tecto ostenta uma alegoria da Santíssima Trindade, pintada sobre estuque. Nas paredes, telas da autoria de André Gonçalves.

en.name: *Mafrash* (Bedding Bag) End Panel
description:
Certain textiles from Anatolia, covers and containers made by nomads, semi-nomads and villagers for their own use known as the Caucasus and Iran, first came to the attention of consumers in Europe, in the final third of the 19th century. Although the Budapest Museum of Applied Arts purchased its first nomad and village flat-woven textiles at the turn of the 19th/20th century, this carpet was a donation by Prof. Ottó Fettick (1946, followed by his bequest in 1954) that laid the real foundations of the Museum's woven carpet collection. The 104 items included textiles of a kind that were new to the Museum: 19th-century woven Caucasian and North Iranian soumak, palas, verneh and jajim rugs, containers and covers, and Anatolian, Iranian and Balkan kilims. Professor Fettick (1875–1954) was a veterinary surgeon, bacteriologist and art collector and probably started building his collection of 19th-century flat-woven nomad carpets and other textiles in the early 20th century. The end panel of a Shahsevan *mafrash* (bedding bag) presumably from the Moghan-Savalan region is from the Fettick collection. Its ornament is comprised of three broad horizontal bands. The dark brown central band has offset rows of hooked hexagons; one row in alternating colours between two rows of white half hexagons. The upper and lower secondary broad bands contain right-facing peacocks standing in line on a yellow ground, each with a stylized "cock" motif on its back.  
  
Originally the side panel selvedges were sewn together with a blue and brown rope-like overcasting which remained on three edges of the end panel when the *mafrash* was taken apart. The cut edge of the long side panel is visible on the lower third of the left side under the frayed overcasting.  
  
There is a *mafrash* end panel of almost identical pattern in the Charles Grant Ellis Collection.
place: South east Caucasus, Moghan–Savalan region (present day Iran Azerbaijan border)
keywords: Cotton; Mafrash; Soumak; Shahsevan; Weft wrapping; Wool
materials: Warp: Wool; Weft: Wool and undyed cotton; Extra-weft wrapping: plain soumak

en.name: Bordj el-Kiffan (Fort de l’Eau)
description:
The fort was part of the defensive system far from Algiers, about 20 kilometres from the chain of batteries all along the coast that were erected a few hundred metres apart by the Ottomans.  
  
It is sometimes called the Eastern Fort, because it is east of Algiers on the road leading to Fort Tamentfoust, or the Water Fort (Fort de l’Eau) for its location near the coast, on a rock that juts over the sea. It was built in 1135 / 1723 by Mohammad Pasha. Its construction date is confirmed by a commemorative plaque discovered above the door in the south wall.  
  
For two days in 1188 / 1775, it was bombarded during a failed attack by the Spanish General Alexander O’Reilly, which necessitated some renovations. It is a square construction of about 20 metres per side. In 1222 / 1808 it had four embrasures facing the sea and four facing the shore, each 2.30 metres wide. Through a vaulted door are seven rooms in a row, including a guard room and a cellar. The central courtyard has a diameter of nine metres.  
  
The staircase from the cellar leads to the terrace, at an elevation of six metres. Its embrasures (three on each side and one at each corner) have been sealed.

fr.name: Bordj el-Kiffan (Fort de l’Eau)
description:
Le *bordj* faisait partie du système défensif éloigné de la ville, à une vingtaine de kilomètres environ du chapelet de batteries installées tout au long de la côte, à quelques centaines de mètres les unes des autres, par les Ottomans.  
Il est appelé fort Oriental car situé à l’est d’Alger, sur la route qui mène à Bordj Tamentefoust, et Fort de l’Eau car construit près du rivage, sur un rocher qui s’avance dans la mer.  
Il fut édifié en 1135/1723 par Mohammad Pacha. La date de sa construction est attestée par une plaque commémorative, retrouvée au-dessus de la porte, dans le mur sud.  
En 1188/1775, il subit, pendant deux jours les bombardements de l’Espagnol O’Reilly qui entraînèrent des modifications.  
C’est une construction carrée d’environ 20 mètres de côté. En 1222/1808, il comportait quatre embrasures vers la mer, quatre autres vers le rivage, chacune d’une largeur de 2,30 mètres.  
Après avoir franchi une porte voûtée, on trouve 7 pièces en enfilade dont une salle de garde et une cave. La cour centrale a un diamètre de 9 mètres.  
Par l’escalier qui part de la cave, on accède à la terrasse, à 6 mètres au-dessus du sol. Ses embrasures (3 sur chaque côté et 1 à chaque angle) ont été obturées.

en.name: View of Torre de los siete Picos, the Alhambra Palace

description: In his travels to Granada Joaquin Sorolla was fascinated by the monument of the Alhambra, the palace of Naridd kingdom of Granada. It is, along with the Mosque of Cordoba, the most important monument of Muslim Spain. Sorolla's paintings are far away from the Orientalism topics, and instead it recreates in the beauty of its nooks and gardens, capturing a more personal and intimate perspective of the monument. In this view from afar, highlights the beauty of the building and its surroundings.

en.name: Ihlamur Pavilion
short_description: The Ihlamur Pavilion is located at the intersection of Nüzhetiye Street between Ihlamur and Tesvikiye and has an area of about 25,000 square meters. The Ihlamur Pavilion consists of two kiosks: the Maiyet and Merasim Kiosk. The Merasim Kiosk was reserved for the sultan’s personal use. The Maiyet Kiosk, the simpler of the two, was used by the sultan’s entourage and family members, and it currently serves as a beautiful cafeteria. The kiosk is decorated with crystal chandeliers, European-style furniture, Hereke carpets, and decorated vases.
